• 3 or more years of experience, ideally in an agency or consulting environment

• Advanced practitioner of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript using current best practices

• Confident with Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review

It's equally important that you can do excellent work without them. AI accelerates good engineers, and the fundamentals still matter. • Effective communicator who genuinely enjoys collaboration
